tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background — the warm cream (light) or deep charcoal (dark) everything sits on. Rebrand: shift hue only, keep lightness.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, search bar, modals, drawers, table body, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed bands and wells: alternating page sections, table header, calendar weekends, input fill on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The deep charcoal band (footer, hero search overlay, admin sidebar). Text on it uses ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse and on photography scrims (15:1 / 17:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and drawers; also the bottom gradient stop over hero photos so ink-inverse reads.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card outlines, table row rules. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, steppers, secondary button). 3.4:1+ on canvas and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (13:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, helper text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken (6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, disabled-looking labels that still must read (4.9:1+ on canvas and surface). Not on surface-sunken in light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand hue — deep moss. Primary buttons, selected dates, active tab rule, checked states. Rebrand: replace accent, accent-hover, accent-soft, on-accent together.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed fill of accent surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: date-range in-between days, selected filter chips, selected table row.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover (8.7:1 both themes). Dark theme flips to dark ink because accent lightens.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent-colored text on canvas, surface and accent-soft (7:1+).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Secondary luxury note — rating stars, eyebrow labels, hairline ornaments, "Signature" ribbons. As text: on canvas, surface, brass-soft (4.5:1+). Never for actions.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind brass text: perks, member-rate tags.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline at 2px offset, landing on canvas or surface (6.4:1+ both themes). Deliberately not the brand hue so it never disappears next to accent buttons.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, Available, Paid — text/dot on success-soft or surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, Awaiting payment, Cleaning — text/dot on warning-soft or surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cancelled, Failed, field errors, destructive buttons — on danger-soft, surface or canvas (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground and error banner fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Checked-in, In house, informational notes — on info-soft or surface.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for info.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Checked-out, Draft, Archived — on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for neutral.

tokens.name: signal-success-inverse
tokens.usage: Success icon disc inside toasts — sits on surface-inverse, which is dark in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-danger-inverse
tokens.usage: Error icon disc inside toasts, on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: signal-info-inverse
tokens.usage: Info icon disc and focus ring inside toasts, on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks; shimmer sweeps toward skeleton-highlight.

tokens.name: skeleton-highlight
tokens.usage: Shimmer highlight inside skeleton blocks.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page, ink-inverse over photography. Mobile: drop to display-lg.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on marketing pages; mobile hero.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles (room detail, checkout, admin page title uses heading-2).

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page; admin page titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles on room cards, modal titles, drawer titles.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Guest testimonials and editorial pull quotes. Italic.
styles.sample: “Buổi sáng ở đây yên tĩnh đến mức nghe rõ tiếng sóng.”

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Nightly price figures and booking totals. Pair the unit in body-sm ink-muted.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sans titles: table section headers, form section labels, toast title, KPI label.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Biệt thự hướng biển với hồ bơi riêng, sân hiên gỗ teak và bồn tắm đá cẩm thạch.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and form values.
styles.sample: Nhận phòng từ 14:00, trả phòng trước 12:00.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy, table cells, helper text, price units.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, tabs, menu items.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above headings and field mini-labels in the search bar. Always set in uppercase, brass or ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to field, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (vertical), list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (horizontal), mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, form field stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; desktop card gutters.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a section; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding (top/bottom).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room; the generous gaps that make it feel boutique.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photography that bleeds to an edge; table cells.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Photos inside cards, badges, checkboxes — the signature near-square corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, toasts, the hero search bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers (inner corner), mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatar, counter buttons in the guest stepper.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards on canvas, sticky table header.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered room card, popovers (date picker, guest picker, select menu), toasts, the floating hero search bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers only.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky header, sticky booking panel.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Date picker, guest picker, select menus.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer scrim + panel.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack, above overlays.
